propositions: The module-size gate shell step exits 1 when the allowlist is fully drained (empty of non-comment lines) because grep returns exit 1 on no-match, which aborts the step under bash -e -o pipefail before the over-cap check runs.
The grep command in the listed= assignment must be guarded with '|| true' to allow the step to continue when the allowlist has no matching entries.
Both .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml and .github/workflows/test.yml contain an identical listed= line that must be updated with the same one-line guard.
The gate must continue to fail (exit 1) when a non-allow-listed file exceeds 800 LOC, preserving the check behavior for non-empty allowlists.
The fix must land on main before the allowlist-emptying reconcile.py change can pass Verified, since the gate runs from main's workflow against each change's tree.
